evidence_tiers.OBSERVED: Direct empirical distributions and 1-D density overlap metrics (OVL, Delta, W1).
evidence_tiers.SUPPORTED: Separability metrics confirmed across multiple clusters and invariant to core-erosion where K >= 5.
evidence_tiers.HYPOTHESIZED: Potential contribution of 1-D overlap to model confusion; requires DIAG-04/05 to confirm.
evidence_tiers.UNKNOWN: Causal root cause of segmentation error; effect of spatial receptive field; gradient dynamics.
